prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a HIGH RESOLUTION 2D GAME UNIT SPRITE ANIMATION TEST STRIP for a faithful HD redraw of Tagrim from Allods Java ME. Source image1 is ORIGINAL image083: EXACT movement direction, compact proportions, silhouette, sword orientation and four walk poses to preserve. Source image2 original085 clarifies equipment/colors from front. Source image3 first portrait gives face/hand-painted HD finish only; do NOT copy tall portrait composition or excessive decorative gold.
EXACTLY FOUR distinct complete sprites in ONE perfectly straight horizontal row on a genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background. No text, labels, outlines of cells, panels, backgrounds, fake checkerboard, floor, particles or baked-in ground shadow. Intended equal cells256x256, overall strip1024x256 or larger with same4:1 aspect, generous consistent invisible padding, each foot/contact anchor at the same height. All sprites same scale, same equipment, same light upper-left, no cropped sword tips.
Character: compact sturdy dark-mustached middle-aged warrior in conical gray steel helmet with small muted-purple plume, chain coif, silver steel shoulders/torso, dark chain/leather lower body, SAPPHIRE BLUE cloth sleeves, burnt ORANGE RED cape falling from shoulders to calves; one long steel sword held in front in the SAME hand throughout, other hand empty. No shield, no new weapons, no huge gold ornaments, no long trailing cloak touching next cell. Strong low-detail silhouette, finely hand-painted interior shading, not pixel art, not a realistic full-body portrait, not a 3D model.
Projection is the original elevated orthographic top-down RPG unit view, slightly looking down onto helmet and shoulders. Every frame faces screen LEFT (true side/left, NEVER turns toward viewer), cape behind body on screen right, sword points toward screen left. Compact body about4 heads high like original, no giant long legs.
Four successive WALK LOOP phases modeled on image083 left-to-right: left foot forward contact, passing under body, opposite foot forward contact, other passing. Clear but modest leg/arm alternation, sword doesn't teleport across hands, cape changes subtly. Keep helmet/shoulder height and body width stable, feet aligned to a common ground line. This is a sprite art TEST candidate, not a guaranteed production-ready atlas. Shape/readability at future160-200px unit height matters more than micro-detail.

spec: EXACTLY FOUR sprites in one straight horizontal row. Each warrior faces AWAY from viewer toward screen TOP, back view, never shows face. Broad orange cape and helmet back are primary silhouette, blue sleeves at sides, sword may appear at one side but never switches hands. Original084 shows orange cape, preserve recognizable back silhouette. Four WALK LOOP phases: first foot contact, passing, opposite contact, second passing. Cape sways subtly with alternating steps, same cape cut/length, no wind gust. At least both boots clearly distinguishable below cape in relevant phase. Do not accidentally render front-facing or rear three-quarter turned face.
